summary: The Buckle, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 15, 2026, furnishing a press release announcing that its Board authorized a quarterly cash dividend of $0.35 per share, payable October 29, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business October 15, 2026. The declaration was made at the Board's quarterly meeting on September 14, 2026. No advisor, premium, or strategic transaction is referenced; this is an ordinary capital-return action by the Nebraska-based specialty retailer, which operates 447 stores in 42 states. The dividend was declared at the Board's quarterly meeting, with no advisor named. Watch for any future deviation in dividend policy or payout coverage.
